payload.comment:
Training stage is structurally sound and internally consistent. Key validations pass: (1) Early stopping logic is correct — best epoch 11, patience 3, stopped at epoch 14; (2) Cosine LR schedule values in history match the expected 15-epoch cosine curve starting at 1e-3; (3) Train loss decreases monotonically (0.7047→0.4993) with no divergence; (4) Val accuracy converges to 0.997401 with no overfitting signal; (5) augmented_train_size 359984 = 89996×4 matches augmentation_factor; (6) All integrity hashes (checkpoint SHA-256, config SHA-256, split index SHA-256) are present; (7) train_stats_only=true ensures no test/val leakage into normalization; (8) test_metrics_used=false and selection_rule explicitly locks the test set. No deterministic findings were raised.

Carried-forward documentation issues (non-blocking but should be corrected before final reporting): (a) data_profile.ambiguity_risks references '96×96 patch resolution' while image_shape_hwc is [28,28,3] — factual error recurring across preprocessing, profiling, and configuration_replay stages; (b) representation_plan.rationale contains model-architecture upgrade text ('hidden 48→64, depth 3→4') rather than a justification for standardize normalization and hflip/vflip/rotate90 augmentation — content misattributed from train_config; (c) llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8 (ollama) across all stage artefacts, leaving LLM-generated narrative without a pinned model fingerprint; (d) Multiple rationale strings in best_configuration, train_config, and representation_plan appear truncated (ending with '…'), risking loss of justification text in downstream audit; (e) Test split originates from a different clinical center (CRC-VAL-HE-7K) with domain shift (imbalance ratio 3.95 vs 1.63; debris ×0.41, stroma ×0.56) — must be explicitly acknowledged in all downstream evaluation reporting; (f) Small per-class test counts (debris n=339, stroma n=421, smooth muscle n=592) will yield high-variance per-class metrics — downstream evaluation should report confidence intervals or macro-averaged metrics.

None of these issues affect the validity of the trained checkpoint or the training process itself. The model, hyperparameters, and convergence behavior are consistent and reproducible given the pinned seed (72) and frozen configuration. Proceed to evaluation with the above documentation corrections applied to the reporting artefacts.
